brief: Data engineering for solo founders — 6 tools that run a real warehouse.

slots.tagline: Open-source workflow automation that ingests, transforms, and loads data without writing heavy code.
slots.f1Body: Design complex ETL pipelines by connecting nodes in a drag-and-drop canvas.
slots.f2Body: Run automations on your own infrastructure to keep data local and costs low.
slots.f3Body: Connect APIs, databases, and webhooks to sync data across your entire stack.

slots.tagline: Open-source Firebase alternative built on Postgres that provides APIs, auth, and storage instantly.
slots.f1Body: Spin up a scalable relational database with row-level security and real-time subscriptions.
slots.f2Body: Instant REST and GraphQL endpoints eliminate boilerplate backend code for your warehouse.
slots.f3Body: Manage users and file assets alongside your data in one unified open-source platform.

slots.tagline: Battle-tested open-source relational database that powers analytical queries and structured storage at scale.
slots.f1Body: Ensure data integrity for every transaction, aggregation, and join in your warehouse.
slots.f2Body: Run window functions, CTEs, and complex aggregations directly where your data lives.
slots.f3Body: Extensions like TimescaleDB and pgvector turn Postgres into a versatile analytical engine.

slots.tagline: Industry-standard container platform that packages your warehouse stack for consistent local and cloud deployment.
slots.f1Body: Eliminate works-on-my-machine issues by shipping your exact dependencies every time.
slots.f2Body: Run multiple services side by side without conflicts on a single cheap VPS.
slots.f3Body: Spin up your entire data stack with a single compose file and minimal configuration.

slots.tagline: In-memory data store that accelerates warehouse dashboards by caching hot queries and session state.
slots.f1Body: Serve frequently accessed metrics instantly without overloading your primary Postgres warehouse.
slots.f2Body: Use Redis Streams to buffer incoming events before they hit persistent storage.
slots.f3Body: Trigger real-time dashboard updates whenever your pipeline finishes a new data load.

slots.tagline: Frontend cloud platform that deploys data dashboards globally with zero-config CI/CD and edge speed.
slots.f1Body: Push your React or Next.js dashboard to Git and watch it deploy automatically in seconds.
slots.f2Body: Serve warehouse visualizations from the nearest edge node to users around the world.
slots.f3Body: Query your warehouse securely through API routes without managing dedicated backend servers.

slots.ctaBody: Deploy a real data warehouse on your own terms. Six tools, one coherent stack, zero enterprise bloat.
